_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Monday — opens W16 as formal capability-disclosure week. (1) Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview rattles cybersecurity — UK AISI publishes first sovereign-regulator capability evaluation of a Glasswing-gated frontier model: Mythos autonomously identified and exploited thousands of zero-days across every major OS and browser including CVE-2026-4747, a 17-year-old NFS RCE in FreeBSD; Anthropic withholds general access, routes to 11-partner consortium (AWS/Apple/Broadcom/Cisco/CrowdStrike/Google/JPMorgan/Linux Foundation/Microsoft/NVIDIA/Palo Alto Networks); regulators not vendors setting the framing. (2) Cloudflare opens Agents Week 2026 — AI Platform reframed as unified inference layer (14+ providers behind single Workers AI binding — OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Meta, Cohere); 20-launch sprint stretching to 20 April; edge becomes agent control plane. (3) Stanford HAI 2026 AI Index + MIT Tech Review chart pack — Anthropic leads frontier rankings as of March, trailed closely by xAI/Google/OpenAI; DeepSeek + Alibaba lag only modestly; 53% generative-AI US adoption faster than PC/internet; $172B annual consumer value; baseline reference for late-April GPT-5.5 / Mythos GA / Gemini 3.1 / DeepSeek V4 race. (4) Oracle stock rallies ~13% leading software bounce-back as AI-disintermediation panic reverses on OCI demand commentary — picks-and-shovels infra vs AI-vulnerable SaaS divergence becomes late-April earnings setup. (5) Bloomberg Opinion 'Anthropic Sets the Right AI Standard' formally publishes; Jack Clark Import AI 453 covers METR/Epoch MirrorCode benchmark + 'ten views on gradual disempowerment'; capability progress accelerated above prior trend lines in cyberoffense — directly relevant to AISI Mythos finding same day. Research: Multi-User LLM Agents (designing past single-principal framing); Process Reward Agents (retrieval-conditioned step grading); Harmful Content Unified Mechanism (jailbreaks + emergent misalignment share circuit); p1 (variance of reward across system-prompt candidates is binding constraint for prompt optimization); Backdoor Attacks on Decentralised Post-Training; Robust Reasoning Benchmark (reasoning models overfit to formatting — 14-technique perturbation collapses performance); Cactus speculative-sampling relaxation; EXAONE 4.5 VLM (first open-weight VLM from LG AI Research). Blogs: Bryan Cantrill via Willison 'peril of laziness lost'; Yegge/Osmani/Hassabis publicly disagree on Google's internal agentic-coding adoption; Anand Topu MCP deep-dive. STAGE MOVES: glasswing-gated-release fast EMA surges on AISI evaluation; autonomous-cyber-capability stays consolidating with momentum.

sectors.name: Methods & research
sectors.description: Depth Ceiling — LLMs execute latent reasoning at varying depths but consistently fail to discover the right multi-step planning strategies — discovery and execution dissociate. Direct evidence that CoT-monitoring captures execution but not strategy selection. MARS multi-token AR generation. SEVerA Formally Guarded Generative Models with first-order-logic specifications + Dafny verification.
